initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(x, y, maxsteps): walk toward point (x, y), one move per turn, about maxsteps moves; slides along mountain walls
SET side = ""
SET fails = 0
REPEAT maxsteps
  SET dx = x - here.x
  SET dy = y - here.y
  IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  SET ax = dx
  IF dx < 0
    SET ax = 0 - dx
  END
  SET ay = dy
  IF dy < 0
    SET ay = 0 - dy
  END
  SET h = "right"
  SET bh = "left"
  IF dx < 0
    SET h = "left"
    SET bh = "right"
  END
  SET v = "up"
  SET bv = "down"
  IF dy < 0
    SET v = "down"
    SET bv = "up"
  END
  SET d1 = h
  SET back = bh
  SET d2 = v
  SET d3 = bv
  IF ay > ax
    SET d1 = v
    SET back = bv
    SET d2 = h
    SET d3 = bh
  END
  IF side == d1 OR side == back
    SET side = ""
  END
  IF side == ""
    SET m = move(d1)
    IF NOT m.ok
      IF m.reason != "blocked"
        RETURN "stopped: " + m.reason
      END
      SET fails = fails + 1
      SET side = d2
    END
  ELSE
    SET m = move(side)
    IF m.ok
      SET m = move(d1)
      IF m.ok
        SET side = ""
      ELSE
        SET fails = fails + 1
      END
    ELSE
      IF m.reason != "blocked"
        RETURN "stopped: " + m.reason
      END
      SET fails = fails + 1
      IF side == d2
        SET side = d3
      ELSE
        SET side = d2
      END
    END
  END
  IF fails > 10
    RETURN "stuck: mountains block the way, pick a waypoint around them"
  END
END
IF here.x == x AND here.y == y
  RETURN "arrived"
END
RETURN "out of moves, not there yet"

initial_skills.name: forage
initial_skills.source:
# forage(): observe this point and absorb every fruit and residue on it
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN "could not observe here"
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + a.effects.gained
    END
  END
  IF e.kind == "residue"
    SET b = absorb(e.id, "essence")
  END
END
IF got > 0
  RETURN "ate"
END
RETURN "no food here now"

  RETURN g
END

RETURN f

initial_skills.name: camp
initial_skills.source:
# camp(rounds): stay here; each turn eat any fruit on this point, otherwise wait 2 turns
REPEAT rounds
  SET r = observe(here)
  SET ate = false
  IF r.ok
    FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
      IF e.kind == "fruit"
        SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        SET ate = true
      END
    END
  END
  IF NOT ate
    wait(2)
  END
END
RETURN "camp over"
